name: A · Head-on
premise: Wind's-eye view: the rider upright shrinks to a tuck, behind a tolerance band.

items.title: Upright to tuck
items.note: S1..S7 2/2/2/2/2/2/1 = 13/14; Amber upright solid behind hunched acid tuck, grey error band on the tuck

items.title: Upright shrinks to tuck
items.note: S1..S7 2/2/2/2/0/2/2 = 12/14; Same without band; cleanest 64 px read, amber flanks and head tip survive blur

items.title: Outline before, tuck after
items.note: S1..S7 2/2/1/1/2/2/2 = 12/14; Upright as amber hairline (the before), solid tuck; outline fades under blur

items.title: Amber shadow, plain tuck
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/2/2/0/2/2 = 11/14; Un-hunched tuck over amber upright; tuck read weaker than 11

items.title: Outline A/B, plain tuck
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/1/2/2/2 = 11/14; Un-hunched tuck over amber outline; weaker tuck read

items.title: Solo tuck, amber band
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/2/2/2/1 = 11/14; Solo tuck, amber band; no comparator so tuck reads as cyclist

items.title: Solo hunched, grey band
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/2/2/2/1 = 11/14; Solo hunched tuck, grey band

items.title: Solo hunched, large
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/2/2/2/1 = 11/14; Solo hunched tuck, larger, amber band

items.title: Dark before, acid after
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/1/1/2/2 = 10/14; Dark upright with grey outline behind tuck; fades at 64 and blur

items.title: Frozen scan
items.note: S1..S7 2/1/1/1/1/2/2 = 10/14; Frozen scan: tuck acid above hairline at 60%, grey below; hairline lost in blur

items.title: Scan with band
